visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a traditional Taiwanese breakfast shop. A man in a blue t-shirt and glasses sits on a black plastic chair outside, looking at his phone. The shop entrance features a large red counter with menu signage above. (2) The camera transitions to the interior of the shop, showing several small tables with purple-topped chairs. Large bookshelves filled with various manga comic books line the side wall, indicating a unique reading area for customers. (3) A sequence of close-up shots follows, focusing on heart-shaped hash browns on a green plate. Chopsticks pick up one hash brown, dipping it into a small pool of red tomato sauce, revealing the white potato texture inside. (4) Hands are seen flipping through the pages of a black-and-white manga comic book. Other dishes are introduced, including vegetable egg pancakes (danbing) and a cheese and egg muffin burger on a green-clothed table. (5) Two plastic cups of milk tea with colorful cartoon lids are shown. A hand adjusts one of the cups. (6) The final phase shows the shop's interior again from a different angle. A staff member in a black shirt stands at the counter while a customer waits. Yellow text overlays with the shop's address appear at the bottom.
